## Functions

### func All

```go
func All[Slice ~ []E, E any](slice Slice) iter.Seq2[int, E]
```

All returns an iterator over index-value pairs in slice.

### func AppendSeq

```go
func AppendSeq[Slice ~ []E, E any](slice Slice, seq iter.Seq[E]) Slice
```

AppendSeq appends values from seq to slice.

### func Backward

```go
func Backward[Slice ~ []E, E any](slice Slice) iter.Seq2[int, E]
```

Backward returns an iterator over index-value pairs from the end of slice.

### func BinarySearch

```go
func BinarySearch[S ~ []E, E cmp.Ordered](slice S, target E) (int, bool)
```

BinarySearch searches for target in a sorted slice.

### func BinarySearchFunc

```go
func BinarySearchFunc[S ~ []E, E, T any](slice S, target T, compare func(E, T) int) (int, bool)
```

BinarySearchFunc searches for target in a sorted slice using compare.

### func Chunk

```go
func Chunk[Slice ~ []E, E any](slice Slice, n int) iter.Seq[Slice]
```

Chunk returns an iterator over consecutive slices of at most n elements.

### func Clip

```go
func Clip[S ~ []E, E any](slice S) S
```

Clip removes unused capacity from the slice.

### func Clone

```go
func Clone[S ~ []E, E any](slice S) S
```

Clone returns a shallow clone of slice, preserving nil.

### func Collect

```go
func Collect[E any](seq iter.Seq[E]) []E
```

Collect collects values from seq into a new slice.

### func Compact

```go
func Compact[S ~ []E, E comparable](slice S) S
```

Compact replaces consecutive runs of equal elements with a single copy.

### func CompactFunc

```go
func CompactFunc[S ~ []E, E any](slice S, equal func(E, E) bool) S
```

CompactFunc is like Compact but uses equal to compare elements.


Compare compares the elements of two slices lexicographically.

```go
func CompareFunc[S1 ~ []E1, S2 ~ []E2, E1, E2 any](left S1, right S2, compare func(E1, E2) int) int
```

CompareFunc compares two slices lexicographically using compare.

### func Concat

```go
func Concat[S ~ []E, E any](values ...S) S
```

Concat concatenates the supplied slices.

### func Contains

```go
func Contains[S ~ []E, E comparable](values S, value E) bool
```

### func ContainsFunc

```go
func ContainsFunc[S ~ []E, E any](values S, predicate func(E) bool) bool
```

### func Delete

```go
func Delete[S ~ []E, E any](slice S, i, j int) S
```

Delete removes the elements slice\[i:j] and returns the modified slice.

### func DeleteFunc

```go
func DeleteFunc[S ~ []E, E any](slice S, remove func(E) bool) S
```

DeleteFunc removes all elements for which remove returns true.

### func Equal

```go
func Equal[S ~ []E, E comparable](left, right S) bool
```

Equal reports whether two slices are equal: the same length and all elements equal. A nil slice and a non-nil empty slice are considered equal.

### func EqualFunc

```go
func EqualFunc[S1 ~ []E1, S2 ~ []E2, E1, E2 any](left S1, right S2, eq func(E1, E2) bool) bool
```

EqualFunc reports whether two slices are equal using eq to compare elements.

### func Grow

```go
func Grow[S ~ []E, E any](slice S, n int) S
```

Grow increases the slice capacity, if necessary, to guarantee space for n additional elements.

### func Index

```go
func Index[S ~ []E, E comparable](values S, value E) int
```

Index returns the index of the first occurrence of value in values, or -1.

### func IndexFunc

```go
func IndexFunc[S ~ []E, E any](values S, predicate func(E) bool) int
```

IndexFunc returns the first index satisfying predicate, or -1.


Insert inserts values at index i, returning the updated slice.
